name: Psalms 23
overview: Psalms 23 presents the LORD as a faithful shepherd who provides and cares for His people, assuring them that they will lack nothing. This Psalm, authored by David, reflects a deep trust in God's guidance and protection amid life's challenges. The imagery aligns with the broader biblical theme of God's intimate knowledge and care for His people, as seen in His sovereign plan and sacrificial love demonstrated through Christ.
